Tragedy in Las Brisas neighborhood (ZIP 33578) : Man Fatally Shoots Estranged Wife in Her Bedroom – POLICE SAY ‘DISRESPECT’ SPARKED KILLING
Las Brisas neighborhood (ZIP 33578) – A quiet Riverview neighborhood was rocked by tragedy early Tuesday morning after a man allegedly shot and killed his estranged wife inside her bedroom, claiming she was “disrespecting” him, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office. The fatal shooting occurred just after 6:30 AM at a residence on Las Brisas Drive, near Balm Riverview Road. Deputies say the suspect, identified as 44-year-old Marcus DeLaney, turned himself in shortly after the incident at a nearby gas station, still in possession of the weapon.
The victim, 43-year-old Teresa DeLaney, had reportedly recently separated from her husband and was living apart while navigating divorce proceedings. According to the arrest affidavit, Marcus told detectives he “snapped” during an argument in her bedroom, then shot her multiple times before fleeing the scene.
Key Facts
-
BREAKING: Woman shot and killed in her bedroom on Las Brisas Dr, Riverview
-
IMPACT: One fatality; suspect in custody, domestic violence suspected
-
OFFICIAL SOURCE: “He stated, ‘She was disrespecting me,’” — HCSO arrest report
-
ACTION: Report signs of escalating domestic conflict to law enforcement immediately
This case has reignited concern among local advocacy groups and officials about the rise in domestic violence incidents in Hillsborough County. So far in 2025, this marks the fourth fatal domestic incident in the county. Advocates are pointing to strained court systems, inadequate supervision of violent offenders, and lack of intervention as contributing factors.
Neighbors describe Teresa as a kind and active member of the community who worked at a nearby school. “She didn’t deserve this,” one resident said. The Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office is urging anyone who sees signs of domestic abuse to report them immediately. A press briefing is scheduled later today to release further details.
Hyperlocal Impact
-
Precise Location:
Las Brisas neighborhood (ZIP 33578) – Off Balm Riverview Rd, near Winthrop Charter School -
Community Connection:
“We heard shouting, then sirens. It’s tragic. She was kind to everyone here.”
(Attribution: – Elena Rojas, local parent and neighbor)
Exclusive Angle
-
WHY THIS MATTERS NOW:
The incident follows a disturbing pattern in Hillsborough County: this is the fourth domestic-related homicide reported in just over six weeks. Community advocates point to overloaded family courts and delays in issuing restraining orders as key factors contributing to the surge. With many offenders released pre-trial, survivors are often left vulnerable.
Crisis Response
-
IMMEDIATE RESOURCES:
» The Spring of Tampa Bay: 813-247-7233 | www.thespring.org
» Florida Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-500-1119 -
OFFICIAL GUIDANCE:
“Don’t wait for it to escalate. We have the resources to help you today.”
(Attribution: – Sheriff Chad Chronister, Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office)
Update Log
-
6:45 AM: Deputies respond to 911 call reporting shots fired
-
7:20 AM: Woman confirmed dead inside master bedroom
-
8:05 AM: Suspect apprehended at BP gas station on Boyette Rd
-
10:30 AM: HCSO schedules 11:00 AM press conference to release more details
